usage: ai-effort-ledger retract [--store FOLDER] [--json] [--language {en,it}] [-h]
                                EVENT IDENTIFIER

retract an event by its event identifier

arguments:
  EVENT IDENTIFIER

options:
  --store FOLDER      use another store folder for this command only
  --json              write the result as one JSON document
  --language {en,it}  the language of the output
  -h, --help          show this help message and exit
